title: StickMenu
description: A simple plugin to make using commands in AdvancedTeleport much easier for console and mobile players.
body:
## 🪵 StickMenu
Stick Menu is a lightweight plugin that lets Bedrock players open the ATP UIs from one place
It works by extending the built-in Bedrock forms from the Advanced Teleport plugin — making menus more accessible to console and mobile players

### 🧩 What It Does
🖱️ Right-click with a stick → opens a UI
🎮 Only works for Bedrock players (Java players won’t see anything)
🔗 Integrates with Advanced Teleport for UI handling and teleportation

### ☑️ Features
🏠 Teleport to saved homes
🔁 Warp to predefined warps (editable warps in plans)
⬇️ Add new homes
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 TPA to online players

### ✅ Requirements
1. Spigot 1.20+ (Paper or Purpur recommended)
2. Advanced Teleport plugin
3. GeyserMC + Floodgate (for Bedrock support)

### 🛠️ Setup
1. Drop StickMenu.jar into your /plugins/ folder
2. Make sure Advanced Teleport is installed and working
3. Restart your server

### 🌎 Warps
Warp support is provided via predefined choices, you must name your warps in ATP the same as shown.

Portal = portal |
Spawn = spawn |
Shops = shops |
Games = games | 
Xp Farm = xp
